# Muscle Car Concepts and Restoration (concept by Kerblabs)

> Muscle and classic car restoration and custom builds in Lincoln, Nebraska. Facts from musclecarconcepts.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Location: 1821 Cornhusker Hwy, Lincoln, NE 68521
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM
- Contact: form on musclecarconcepts.com; Instagram and YouTube @muscle_car_concepts. No phone published.

## Services
- Custom paint
- Frame off restoration
- Engine upgrades
- Custom upholstery
- Suspension and handling
- Custom fabrication
